name: application-invoice-table
title: Invoice Table
description: Line-item invoice table with a status badge and a computed subtotal/tax/total footer — every dollar figure is derived from the real line items and tax rate, not hand-typed.
useWhen: Displaying a billing invoice with individual line items and a computed total.
You need the subtotal, tax, and grand total to always match the underlying line items exactly.
A status badge (paid/pending/overdue) should be shown alongside the invoice.
avoidWhen: You need generic sortable/filterable tabular data — use the plain tables component instead.
There's no financial total to compute — a details-list or plain table is simpler.
You need multi-currency or per-line tax rates — extend the computation before reusing this markup.
responsiveBehavior: The table scrolls horizontally within its container on narrow viewports rather than collapsing columns, preserving the tabular alignment of quantities and amounts.
accessibility: Column headers use scope='col' so screen readers announce which column a cell belongs to.
The status badge uses both background color and a text label (Paid/Pending/Overdue), not color alone.
Subtotal, tax, and total rows are in a real <tfoot> so assistive tech distinguishes them from line-item data rows.

variants.title: Invoice table
variants.description: Three-item invoice (INV-2026-0142) with a Pending status badge and a computed $9,806.40 total including 8% tax, on a light surface.
accessibility: Amount and total columns are right-aligned for scannable numeric comparison.

variants.title: Invoice table (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-item invoice, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Table border, text, and status badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
